name: test_system_matrix
intent: Machine-readable starter matrix for mapping maintained test surfaces to governance tiers without changing CI behavior.

ci_authority.note: This matrix is advisory metadata only; CI remains bound to the smoke suite until explicitly changed elsewhere.

smoke.meaning: Fast, high-signal regression coverage allowed to gate CI.

focused.meaning: Small domain-oriented suites for local pre-merge checks and targeted ownership review.

local.meaning: Developer-run suites that may be broader or more environment-sensitive than focused suites.

manual.meaning: Human-invoked checks, diagnostics, or workflows that need judgment or special setup.

nightly.meaning: Candidate long-running or broad regression coverage for scheduled automation after stabilization.

systems.label: Runtime facade
systems.governance_notes: Keep facade layering and public step evidence in smoke; broader facade loop variants can stay focused/local.

systems.label: Engagement adapters and evidence
systems.governance_notes: Directory-level smoke coverage already exists; focused suite keeps a smaller explicit adapter subset.

systems.label: World batch and vec-env adapters
systems.governance_notes: Runtime smoke keeps the core batch path; local/focused can expand to single-world and vec-env adapter checks.

systems.label: Air combat runtime
systems.governance_notes: Keep representative fixture and ROE coverage local/focused until runtime cost and flake profile are reviewed.

systems.label: Naval runtime and unit contracts
systems.governance_notes: Python runtime checks and JSON contracts are tracked together, but contract execution remains with existing contract runners.

systems.label: Ground runtime and task-order contracts
systems.governance_notes: Start with schema/guardrail coverage before promoting heavier scenario checks.

systems.label: Training entry/config/bootstrap
systems.governance_notes: Track training bootstrap separately from frozen model contracts so environment-sensitive training checks can remain local.

systems.label: Route generator contracts
systems.governance_notes: Contract-only surface; keep under contract runners rather than pytest suite manifests.

systems.label: Simulation kernel throttle scan
systems.governance_notes: Parameter-scan style checks are matrix-tracked but not added to CI by this change.

systems.label: Frozen training contracts
systems.governance_notes: Frozen artifact checks are tracked as protected contracts; promotion to nightly should happen only after artifact availability is stable.

systems.label: Environment regression contracts
systems.governance_notes: Documented as local contract coverage; this change does not add env_regression to CI.
